provider.description: A key manager's provider: openbao (OpenBao or Vault), doppler, onepassword (1Password) or bitwarden (Bitwarden Secrets Manager).

anyOf.description: A key-manager connection's label, which people know it by: 1 to 100 characters on one line.

label.description: The label of the connection the reference is read through; null when this environment holds no connection by its id.

locator.description: Where the value sits, on one line: OpenBao's mount and path with the key (personal/harness/forge-github (key token)), a Doppler name with its project and config, 1Password's op:// reference, a Bitwarden key with its secret id. Never the value.

display.description: A key-manager reference as a person reads it: the provider, the connection's label and the locator, never the value.

connectionId.description: The key-manager connection the reference names.

oneOf.description: The key-manager reference could not be read: no key-manager connection on this environment holds it, the connection is not signed in, or the key manager could not be asked now. Nothing was changed; the message says which, and data names the connection.

connectionId.description: The key-manager connection the reference names.

oneOf.description: The key manager holds nothing at the reference's locator: no secret at its path, or no key by its name in the secret. Nothing was changed; data names the connection.

connectionId.description: The key-manager connection the reference names.

oneOf.description: The key manager refused the connection's login the read. OpenBao refuses a path the login may not read, a path that is not there and a mount that is not there alike, so the message says to check the mount first, then the path and the login's policies. Nothing was changed; data names the connection.

connectionId.description: A key-manager connection's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

anyOf.description: Why a key-manager reference does not resolve: credential_source_unavailable, reference_not_found, reference_denied or provider_unavailable, as a resolve refuses it.

problem.description: Why the reference does not resolve, as a resolve refuses it; null when it resolves.
